responsibility: Defines the RTL operand predicates used by MN10300 instruction patterns. These predicates recognize target-specific constants, call operands under PIC and non-PIC modes, problematic stack-pointer plus forms, AM33-only immediate allowances, label refs, integer condition-code registers, LIW operands, and the parallel form used for multi-register stores, allowing mn10300.md patterns to discriminate legal operands beyond generic GCC predicates.
